scientific_integrity: The optimal mean-work transport and its first two work moments originate in the cited literature. The new result concerns fourth-order sign, exact finite-duration recursion, large-duration standardized coefficient and a cyclic sign counterexample. Numerical checks corroborate but do not prove continuum statements.
scientific_limitations: Stationary symmetric one-dimensional telegraph drive; fixed positive trap stiffness and switching decorrelation rate; nonnegative thermal diffusivity; nonzero propulsion speed; prescribed finite-variation trap-center protocols. Strict negative fourth cumulant requires a nonconstant monotone protocol. Cyclic positivity holds for short delay and sufficiently large fixed finite stiffness. Results concern work fluctuations, not feedback or general non-Gaussian propulsion.
title: A fourth-cumulant sign law for telegraphic particles in moving harmonic traps
